title: TS-26 Turn grants and the Pi tool gate
description:
## Slice 2 ticket 26 of 40, phase notes: paths use `conversation/` (the workspace as it is on develop). Design source: `git show origin/docs/typescript-control-plane:docs/TYPESCRIPT_CONTROL_PLANE.md` (section 8, row 26); read sections 0.3, 2, 3 and 6 as needed. Read AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md first. Never read or write `project/`; use `kbs` only.

## Goal
Implement the turn grant (PUT /turns/{id}/grant) and the gate that wraps every model tool so policy, grant and approval are evaluated before the tool runs. Wrapping Pi tools is unverified API.

## Kind
prototype-first: a library API in this ticket is uncertain. A Sonnet agent must FIRST produce verified, runnable code for it (see Prototype section), paste it into this ticket as a comment, and ONLY THEN is the ticket completed with that code verbatim. A Haiku implementer must not start the build part until that comment exists; if it is missing, stop and report.

## Branch and commit
```text
git fetch origin
git switch -c ts/26-turn-grants-and-the-pi-tool-gate origin/develop
...work, then...
git add <only the files listed under Files>
git commit -m "feat(conversation): turn grants and the Pi tool gate

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"
git push -u origin ts/26-turn-grants-and-the-pi-tool-gate
```
Do NOT open a pull request; the orchestrator opens it. Commit messages contain no emojis.

## Files to create or change
- `conversation/src/policy/turn-grant.ts`
- `conversation/src/pi/gate.ts`
- `conversation/src/http/routes/grants.ts`
- `conversation/features-support/steps/grant.steps.ts`
- `conversation/features-support/steps/model-tool-loop-sinks.steps.ts`

## Exported interface and error behavior
`gateTool(tool: PiTool, deps): PiTool` returns a tool with the same name and schema whose `execute` first calls the policy kernel with (sink, grant, ceiling, approval) and returns a denial result (not an exception) when denied. Grant item: pk `{t}#turn#{id}` sk `grant` (unchanged from Python).

General rules: TypeScript ESM, `.ts` import suffixes as in conversation/src/storage/; tabs for indentation as in existing files; long clear names; no line comments; TSDoc on exported symbols; no emojis. Each Python exception class used by a ported function becomes an exported `Error` subclass with the same name and the same message text. Failures are thrown, never returned as magic values, unless the Python returned them.

## Prototype (must be done and pasted before the build)
A Sonnet agent proves how to wrap or decorate a registered Pi tool's `execute` and return a denial result that the model sees as a tool result, using the scripted provider from ticket 18. Pasted into the ticket.

## Behavior spec (Gherkin, ported unchanged)
Existing features that must pass under cucumber-js when this ticket closes. Do NOT edit these `.feature` files except where this ticket says a behavior changed.

## Stop rules
If anything in this ticket is wrong, ambiguous, impossible, or contradicted by the code you find (a Python line range does not match, a step has no Python match, a library API differs from what is written, a scenario cannot pass without changing its text), STOP and report to the orchestrator with the exact file, line and observation.
